scenes.headline: What a fine-tune changed inside Qwen3.5-9B
scenes.sub: Alpie Seed 9B, compared tensor by tensor
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Diya! Alpie Seed is a fine-tune of a public model, so we can diff it against its base.

scenes.text: Alpie Seed is Qwen3.5-9B with two merged DoRA adapters, and comparing the two checkpoints shows exactly which weights the training touched.
scenes.say: Same architecture, same shapes. So every difference between the two files is the training.

items.say: Start from the base model, frozen.
Train a DoRA adapter on examples, aimed at the attention and MLP projections by name.
A second adapter learns from rewards, comparing eight answers to one prompt.
Both are merged into the base and saved as ordinary bf16 weights.

steps.say: Every MLP changed. Their matrices are named gate, up and down, which are on the adapter's list.
The eight full attention layers changed too. Their projections are called q, k, v and o.
The twenty four DeltaNet layers did not move. Their matrices have other names, so the adapters never attached.
The embeddings, the output head and the vision tower are Qwen's, byte for byte.

scenes.title: Why each weight moved one step
scenes.say: Why so tidy? Because of rounding.

parts.say: Each base weight already sits exactly on the bf16 grid.

parts.note: about 0.2% of the value or less
parts.say: The merged update is tiny, mostly less than half a grid step.

parts.note: stay put, or move exactly one step
parts.say: So rounding either leaves the weight where it was, or moves it exactly one step. Never two.

scenes.label: of all values differ from the base, each by one bf16 step
scenes.say: Across the checkpoint, about four point nine percent of the values differ. Every changed one by a single step.

scenes.title: Prompt tokens for one Hi
scenes.say: The chat templates changed too. The two bit file adds over two thousand tokens of policy to every conversation.

scenes.text: A merged adapter looks like a full fine-tune on disk; diff it against the base to see what really changed.
scenes.say: A merged adapter hides in plain sight. Diff it against its base, and render the prompt your runtime sends.

recap: Only MLPs and attention layers moved
One bf16 step per changed weight
Templates add identity and policy text
scenes.say: MLPs and attention moved, one step at a time, and the templates add their own text.
